8.20. iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods¶

This module provides builtin table methods and helpers for creating custom table methods.

Functions

arguments(**kwargs) Decorator providing argument validation for table methods.
assertDistinctElements(lst, attrib) Convenience function for table method argument validation.
assertNonEmpty(lst, attrib) Convenience function for table method argument validation.
getTable(tableName, localTables) Returns the LCF table named tableName if it has been registered in Prover iLock’s table store, or if it is a locally defined table.
getTableSig(name, lcfPackageData, …) Returns the signature (the names and types of all columns) for the given table.
opt(type[, default]) Used to specify that a table method argument is optional.
